item.description: With the midterm elections fast approaching, fierce debates were held in three critical races Thursday night. It comes as a recent NBC News poll found that inflation and the cost of issue is the top issue for voters with government corruption coming in at No. 2. Now, President Donald Trump’s ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, is under growing scrutiny after a top Trump donor alleged she asked him to pay her $100,00 American Express bill. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

item.description: Outrage and intense protests erupted in New York after ICE agents opened fire on a 28-year-old man in a car with a 5-year-old child in the backseat. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.
